authority.freeze_rule: This lifecycle is frozen before the corrected gateway oracle is implemented. Baseline or proposed-method outcomes are not valid reasons to change data location, action ownership or completion semantics.

scope.protected_completion: source-deadline monitoring obligation reaches the required center/platform
scope.conditional_entry_boundary: the report has reached the gateway queue
scope.claim_boundary: This gateway-backhaul slice does not claim to model or optimize node-to-gateway access. End-to-end access remains a separate extension.

source_owned_invariants: The original monitoring obligation release/deadline remains source-owned; entering the gateway-backhaul slice does not rewrite its deadline.
Monitoring completion is platform/center delivery, not gateway receipt.
Source-defined communication priority/fallback constraints remain binding.
Reconnect backlog priority remains unresolved where the source does not define it.

data_locations.meaning: report exists at sensor/access side but is not yet available to the gateway-backhaul policy
report is present in gateway queue and is eligible for gateway-local forwarding decisions
gateway has committed the report to the primary terrestrial backhaul and awaits lawful completion/failure feedback
gateway has committed the report to an authorized fallback path and awaits declared completion/failure feedback
the report has reached the required center/platform within the task contract

entry_event.effect: moves report from UPSTREAM_OF_GATEWAY to GATEWAY_READY
entry_event.note: If a future end-to-end benchmark makes node uplink controllable, it must separately declare node/control ownership and transport. The gateway-backhaul slice does not infer that authority.

gateway_legal_actions.precondition: report location == GATEWAY_READY and a declared primary opportunity/capacity unit is available
gateway_legal_actions.effect: consume primary opportunity/capacity and move report to PRIMARY_IN_FLIGHT
gateway_legal_actions.natural_feedback: local execution result plus later center ACK/timeout according to the declared backhaul feedback process

gateway_legal_actions.precondition: report location == GATEWAY_READY, fallback is source-authorized, and declared fallback opportunity/budget is available
gateway_legal_actions.effect: consume fallback opportunity/budget and move report to FALLBACK_IN_FLIGHT

gateway_legal_actions.precondition: always legal unless the task contract forbids waiting past a deadline
gateway_legal_actions.effect: advance to the next declared event without fabricating an observation

forbidden_gateway_shortcuts: Treat node-to-gateway SEND_TERR as an instantaneous gateway-local action without a gateway-to-node control/access contract.
Generate a future gateway receipt as the consequence of FORWARD_PRIMARY; the report is already at the gateway before gateway forwarding begins.
Count owner-local gateway queue/receipt reads as paid remote acquisition.
Mark an obligation complete at gateway receipt; completion remains required center/platform delivery.
Let gateway policy read future primary service transitions or future satellite opportunities beyond the declared public geometry.

owner_local: local execution acceptance/failure when the implementation can lawfully know it

implementation_gate: Corrected gateway oracle must represent report location or an equivalent state invariant.
Corrected gateway oracle must expose only FORWARD_PRIMARY/FORWARD_FALLBACK/WAIT at this placement.

The v0.7 gateway_receipt_delay axis may not be silently reused as feedback after gateway forwarding; its role must be removed, projected out or moved to a separate access extension before exact admission.
Existing v0.7 source task, public geometry and process-support lineage may be reused only where their semantics remain compatible with this lifecycle.
A bounded corrected pilot must pass ownership/transition replay before any hardness claim is reconsidered.
